housing.summary: Numbeo reports an August 2026 average of USD 1,762 per month for a one-bedroom apartment in the city centre. Zillow provides Phoenix-specific rental listings. No sourced market-typical deposit norm was found.

banking.summary: Bank of America says an international professional opening an account in person needs a foreign and U.S. address, two forms of identification, and a foreign tax identification number; an SSN is not required unless issued.
required_docs: Proof of foreign home or permanent residence address
Two forms of identification: one accepted primary ID and one accepted secondary ID
Foreign tax identification number, or U.S. TIN/ITIN if issued

schools.summary: International Baccalaureate curriculum is available at North High School in Phoenix; the linked GreatSchools Phoenix directory lists city schools.

legal_admin.summary: Noncitizens subject to the federal alien address-reporting rule must report a change of address to USCIS within 10 days of moving; A and G visa holders and visa-waiver visitors are exempt.
legal_admin.registration_step: Submit the address change through a USCIS online account or file paper Form AR-11 within 10 days of moving when the federal rule applies.

tax_finance.summary: A newcomer eligible for an SSN applies on Form SS-5; a person who cannot obtain an SSN but needs a U.S. tax-processing number applies to the IRS for an ITIN on Form W-7 with identity and foreign-status documentation and generally a federal tax return.
tax_finance.tax_id_name: Social Security Number (SSN) or Individual Taxpayer Identification Number (ITIN)

transport.summary: Valley Metro is the regional public-transport network. Smart Fare replaces an upfront monthly pass with pay-as-you-go fare capping; the full-fare local bus and light-rail monthly maximum is USD 64.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Temporary visitors may drive with a valid home-country licence. Arizona residents must obtain an Arizona licence; licences from Canada, Germany, South Korea, and Taiwan receive written and road testing exemptions, while applicants from other countries must take both tests. https://azdot.gov/mvd/services/driver-license-ID/driver-license-foreign-applicants
transport.healthcare_registration: There is no automatic universal public-healthcare registration. Eligible Arizona residents can apply for AHCCCS Medical Assistance online through Health-e-Arizona Plus or use the application routes listed by AHCCCS. https://azahcccs.gov/Members/GetCovered/apply.html
